meta.oag_tonnage_note: The hackathon PDF mentions tonnage; official Flight Info API Content parameters (docs updated 2024-09-13) list only Status, Seats, ActualSeats, ExtendedSchedules. Cargo kg/m3 are taken from the cargo kanban snapshot, not labelled as OAG.
